review_text: Went here on a Friday morning around 9:00 and they were busy, but staff moved quickly to fill orders. The place was clean and there weee people seated and enjoying their coffee and donuts. I wanted to try something new and ordered the Vietnamese Coffee. I had not tried one before so I didn't know how it should taste. I took it home to drink and found it to be bold and a little sweeter than I typically like coffee, but still enjoyable. Comfort room was clean and staff was efficient and helpful.

"I usually stop by Dunkin' after my morning walk at People's Park, and it's always a convenient choice when I'm starving after a good exercise. The location is very accessible, especially for those spending time in the park. The staff are friendly and welcoming, which makes the visit even more pleasant. The place is also clean and well-maintained, so it's comfortable to sit down and enjoy your coffee and snacks. Definitely a go-to spot for a quick and satisfying break."
